title: 要还是不要  (Do You Want It or Not?)

segments.t: Out at the open-plan desks, senior producer Xingzi tells Bu Xiaogu the truth about why Wang Er was dismissed and offers her a place in the chief editor's office, while Chun Yuqiao drops off her next urgent task. Listen first.
布小谷，你现在在总编室工作了。
如果你愿意，毕业以后可以留在星天。
那王尔老师呢？
他把艺人方案透露给竞争对手了。
王尔要负责，已经被公司开除了。
你们为什么要这么对他？
我们怎么了？
这份工作，你要还是不要？
这个是你的下一个任务。
我们要做明星之夜的艺人初选。
如果你准备留下，明天给我结果。
Let's go through their conversation step by step. Xingzi delivers the surprise news first.
布小谷，你现在在总编室工作了。
'Bu Xiaogu, you work in the chief editor's office now.' Put the workplace "zai zongbianshi" right before "gongzuo", 'work', and finish with "le" to mark the new change.
如果你愿意，毕业以后可以留在星天。
'If you are willing, you can stay at Xingtian after graduation.' "Yuanyi" means 'willing', and "biye yihou" puts "biye", 'graduate', before "yihou", 'after'.
那王尔老师呢？
'Then what about Wang Er?' Adding "ne" right after a person's name asks 'and what about...?' without needing an action word.
他把艺人方案透露给竞争对手了。
'He leaked the artist plan to our competitor.' "Toulu" means 'leak' or 'disclose', and "jingzheng duishou" pairs 'compete' with 'opponent' for a business rival.
王尔要负责，已经被公司开除了。
'Wang Er had to take responsibility and has already been fired by the company.' "Fuze" means 'bear responsibility', while "bei gongsi kaichu" marks who dismissed him with "bei".
你们为什么要这么对他？
'Why did you have to treat him like that?' Here "dui ta" means 'toward him', with "zheme", 'like this', tucked right in front.
我们怎么了？
'What did we do wrong?' Three quick syllables — "women zenme le" — push back with 'what is wrong with us?'.
这份工作，你要还是不要？
'This job — do you want it or not?' Jobs take the measure word "fen" in "zhe fen gongzuo", and "haishi" frames an either-or choice in a question.
这个是你的下一个任务。
'This is your next assignment.' "Xia yi ge", literally 'next one', introduces "renwu", the standard workplace word for an assignment or mission.
我们要做明星之夜的艺人初选。
'We need to do the first round of artist picks for Star Night.' "Chuxuan" joins "chu", 'initial', with "xuan", 'select', for a first-round shortlist.
如果你准备留下，明天给我结果。

'If you plan to stay, give me the results tomorrow.' "Zhunbei" means 'plan to' or 'get ready to', and "jieguo" is the word for 'result' or 'outcome'. Let's hear the whole conversation again at natural speed.
布小谷，你现在在总编室工作了。
如果你愿意，毕业以后可以留在星天。
那王尔老师呢？
他把艺人方案透露给竞争对手了。
王尔要负责，已经被公司开除了。
你们为什么要这么对他？
我们怎么了？
这份工作，你要还是不要？
这个是你的下一个任务。
我们要做明星之夜的艺人初选。
如果你准备留下，明天给我结果。

Stunned by the truth about Wang Er, Xiaogu takes the Star Night assignment file with just one night to deliver results. You learned "yuanyi" for 'willing', "yaohaishi bu yao" choices with "haishi", and "renwu" for 'assignment'. See you next time!
明天见！
